questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: She wants ______ a new phone.
questions.explanation: want 后面接 to do，表示想要做某事。
questions.evidence: She wants to buy a new phone.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: They enjoy ______ to music.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接 doing，表示喜欢做某事。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The letter ______ yesterday.
questions.explanation: 被动语态：be + 过去分词，表示信被寄出。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: I plan ______ my grandmother this weekend.
questions.explanation: plan 后面接 to do，表示计划做某事。
questions.evidence: I plan to visit my grandmother this weekend.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: He keeps ______ the same question.
questions.explanation: keep 后面接 doing，表示反复做某事。
questions.evidence: He keeps asking the same question.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The cake ______ by my sister every year.
questions.explanation: 被动语态：is + 过去分词，表示蛋糕被制作。
questions.evidence: The cake is made by my sister every year.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: We decided ______ the meeting early.
questions.explanation: decide 后面接 to do，表示决定做某事。
questions.evidence: We decided to start the meeting early.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: She is interested in ______ new languages.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后面接 doing，表示对做某事感兴趣。
questions.evidence: She is interested in learning new languages.

title: The Support Team Debate · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
英语中常用 'to + 动词原形' 表示目的，例如 'to help our customers'（为了帮助客户）。有些动词后面常接 to do，如 want to do, plan to do, decide to do；有些动词后面常接 doing，如 enjoy doing, keep doing。被动语态的基本结构是 'be + 过去分词'，表示“被……”，例如 'The chatbot is designed to give quick answers.'（聊天机器人被设计用来快速回答）。

We need to decide how to use new software to help our customers.
